note: Sealed set of the team-arms comparison (B4), 70 cases, written 2026-11-24 by an independent case-author session after the dev set, with fresh wordings and situations. Run once at the end; nobody who changes an arm reads it.

cases.title: Score accounts that won't renew, seven days ahead
cases.opening: Seven days ahead of each account's renewal date, can we score which accounts won't renew by that date?

replies.text: Right: not renewing by the renewal date.

must_understand: Outcome: no renewal by the contractual date
Moment: seven days before renewal

renewed_by_date is excluded from inputs

cases.title: Churn never defined
cases.opening: Seven days before renewal, which accounts will churn?

must_understand: The team must ask what churn means and wait

cases.title: Person needs to check with a manager
cases.opening: Rank accounts by churn risk seven days before renewal.

forbidden: Record an outcome the person never chose

cases.title: Stop being a customer, on a table without renewal dates
cases.opening: Seven days before renewal, who is likely to stop being a customer?

replies.text: Explicit cancellation.

must_understand: Whatever the outcome, the table has no renewal date, so the moment cannot be fixed
Business supplies the dates

cases.notes: Even once the outcome is settled the renewal date is missing. A team may or may not ask about the outcome first; the end is the same.

cases.title: Terminate their contract

replies.text: Explicit cancellation: they terminate the contract.

must_understand: Terminating a contract is an explicit cancellation
cancelled_at records it; cancellation_reason is a late column

cases.title: Downgrades: an outcome nobody records
cases.opening: Seven days before renewal, which accounts are likely to downgrade to a cheaper plan?

replies.text: I mean moving to a cheaper plan at renewal. Not leaving and not cancelling.

must_understand: A downgrade is neither cancellation nor non-renewal
The table holds only the current plan, no plan history
Business would need to supply plan-change records
forbidden: Rank by non-renewal and call it downgrade risk

cases.notes: Author unsure: a team might also end on a question. Chose a blocker: the outcome is clear and its record is missing.
